mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS userId, student_id AS studentId, username AS userName, password, email, role FROM user WHERE student_id = #{studentId}
SELECT user_id AS userId, student_id AS studentId, username AS userName, password, email, role FROM user WHERE email = #{email}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user (student_id, username, password, email, role) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{userName}, #{password}, #{email}, #{role})
